marco: Proposal: add a left-nav coachmark hotspot for first-run users that expands into inline microtasks (connect API key, try playground, load demo data). Less modal, stays contextual to the flows. Mock: https://img.redwood.in/coachmark-hotspot.png tess: I like keeping it contextual. Two concerns: discoverability if the left nav is collapsed by default, and mobile behavior. Where does keyboard focus land when the panel expands? marco: Plan: hotspot lives on the primary nav item and expands an inline panel anchored to the nav. When opened, focus moves into the panel but we don’t trap it; ESC collapses and returns focus to the hotspot. Screen reader should announce "Onboarding panel opened" via a role=status element. anya: Copy nudge: update CTA copy to be clearer: 'Connect your first API key' (vs generic 'Connect API key'), and show time estimates like '(~2 min)'. For demo data use 'Load demo data' instead of 'Import sample' 1 fewer jargon surprises for new users. tess: A11y: since its not modal I prefer role="region" with aria-labelledby + aria-live="polite". Hotspot button should have aria-expanded toggles. Also ensure visible focus (3px ring) and 44px min touch targets. dev-bot: Feature flag created: left_nav_coachmark_v1. Experiment variants: inline|modal. marco: Telemetry plan: `coachmark_shown`, `coachmark_open`, `coachmark_action` with action values connect_key|playground|load_demo|dismiss. Include `variant:inline|modal` and `session_step` metric. Also track `focus_count` for accessibility analytics. anya: Contrast: current mock button text ratio is ~3.0:1 for some secondary buttons. We need to reach 4.5:1; either darken text color or use semi-bold. Also ensure hover/focus states meet contrast. marco: UX edgecases: if a user is on a Dedicated/Private deployment, show a contextual hint/link to contact their account rep rather than demo data. Also add a subtle "Not now" secondary action to reduce friction. tess: Keyboard flow: open hotspot (Enter) -> focus moves to first actionable button -> Tab moves forward through CTAs -> ESC collapses and emits coachmark_action=dismiss. Enter on buttons triggers corresponding action and logs telemetry. marco: Dev snippet for the panel (for devs to adapt):

Get started

anya: Also add `role="status" aria-live="polite"` element to announce state changes (e.g., "Demo data loaded"). For images inside cards mark decorative ones as aria-hidden. tess: Decision: run inline left-nav panel as a 2-week experiment with the `left_nav_coachmark_v1` flag, use Anya's copy updates, apply contrast fixes, add telemetry events and `focus_count` metric. Marco will update Figma frames and open the PR. Devs to implement ARIA attributes per snippet and ensure mobile collapses to a full-width sheet if necessary. marco: Thanks all 60; please tag me on the PR and well run the experiment next sprint.
